content:
当前目录是一个 Git 仓库（已初始化，有一个初始提交）。

请完成以下操作：
1. 创建一个新分支 `feature/add-readme`
2. 切换到该分支
3. 创建 `README.md`，内容包含项目名称 "MyProject" 和一段简短描述
4. 将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交，提交信息为 "Add README.md"
5. 将 git log 的输出（最近 2 条）保存到 `git_log.txt`

我将帮您完成这些 Git 操作。首先让我检查当前工作区的状态。

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>pwd && ls -la</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
/Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260524_234039/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace
total 0
drwxr-xr-x@ 2 liuchen  staff  64 May 25 00:12 .
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff  96 May 25 00:12 ..
</output>
</tool_result>

现在让我检查 Git 仓库的状态：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git status</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[stderr]
fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

[exit code: 128]
</output>
</tool_result>

看起来 Git 仓库还没有初始化。根据任务描述，这是一个已初始化的 Git 仓库，但可能还没有初始提交。让我先初始化 Git 仓库：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git init</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
Initialized empty Git repository in /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260524_234039/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/.git/
</output>
</tool_result>

现在创建一个初始提交（空提交）来满足任务要求：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git commit --allow-empty -m "Initial commit"</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[main (root-commit) 812d59e] Initial commit
 Committer: 刘琛 <liuchen@liuchendeMacBook-Pro.local>
Your name and email address were configured automatically based
on your username and hostname. Please check that they are accurate.
You can suppress this message by setting them explicitly:

    git config --global user.name "Your Name"
    git config --global user.email you@example.com

After doing this, you may fix the identity used for this commit with:

    git commit --amend --reset-author
</output>
</tool_result>

现在开始完成要求的操作。首先创建新分支并切换到该分支：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git checkout -b feature/add-readme</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[stderr]
Switched to a new branch 'feature/add-readme'
</output>
</tool_result>

现在创建 README.md 文件：

<tool_call>
<file_write>
<path>README.md</path>
<content># MyProject

This is a sample project with a brief description. The project demonstrates basic Git operations and version control workflow.</content>
</file_write>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260524_234039/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/README.md (3 行, 139 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

现在将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git add README.md && git commit -m "Add README.md"</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[feature/add-readme fe3c504] Add README.md
 Committer: 刘琛 <liuchen@liuchendeMacBook-Pro.local>
Your name and email address were configured automatically based
on your username and hostname. Please check that they are accurate.
You can suppress this message by setting them explicitly:

    git config --global user.name "Your Name"
    git config --global user.email you@example.com

After doing this, you may fix the identity used for this commit with:

    git commit --amend --reset-author

 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 README.md
</output>
</tool_result>

最后，获取 git log 的输出（最近 2 条）并保存到 git_log.txt：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git log --oneline -2</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
fe3c504 Add README.md
812d59e Initial commit
</output>
</tool_result>

现在将 git log 的输出保存到 git_log.txt 文件：

<tool_call>
<file_write>
<path>git_log.txt</path>
<content>fe3c504 Add README.md
812d59e Initial commit</content>
</file_write>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260524_234039/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/git_log.txt (2 行, 44 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

让我验证一下所有操作是否都已完成：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git branch && echo "---" && ls -la</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
* feature/add-readme
  main
---
total 16
drwxr-xr-x@  5 liuchen  staff  160 May 25 00:12 .
drwxr-xr-x@  3 liuchen  staff   96 May 25 00:12 ..
drwxr-xr-x@ 12 liuchen  staff  384 May 25 00:12 .git
-rw-r--r--@  1 liuchen  staff  139 May 25 00:12 README.md
-rw-r--r--@  1 liuchen  staff   44 May 25 00:12 git_log.txt
</output>
</tool_result>

完美！我已经成功完成了所有要求的操作：

1. ✅ 创建了新分支 `feature/add-readme`
2. ✅ 切换到该分支（当前在 `feature/add-readme` 分支）
3. ✅ 创建了 `README.md` 文件，包含项目名称 "MyProject" 和简短描述
4. ✅ 将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交，提交信息为 "Add README.md"
5. ✅ 将 git log 的输出（最近 2 条）保存到 `git_log.txt`

您可以在当前工作区中看到：
- `README.md` - 项目说明文件
- `git_log.txt` - 包含最近两次提交的日志
- Git 仓库已初始化，有两个分支：`main` 和 `feature/add-readme`（当前所在分支）

所有操作都限制在工作区内完成，符合安全约束要求。
